title: contributeToPoolInput
description: The request contribute-to-pool.mjs reads via --request or stdin: a member funding the pool from their own sleeve.

account.description: The contributing member's internal pool-ledger account id.

amount.description: Exact decimal string, denominated in commodity.

commodity.description: The commodity this contribution is denominated in (e.g. "HBD").

sourceSleeve.description: The member's own ledger account id the contribution is drawn from.
